cprog-w1-q1.explanation: The Program Counter (PC) holds the address of the next instruction; it moves forward after each fetch, and a jump instruction gives it a new address. cprog-w1-q3.question: A toy CPU program is stored in memory starting at address 100. What value is in R1 when HALT is reached?

cprog-w1-q10.question: A computer has 1 MB (1,048,576 bytes) of memory and every byte needs its own address. At least how many bits must an address have?
